The *Atthāpattisamuṭṭhāna* (Pvr 18) is the eighteenth section of the *Parivāra*, the concluding analytical treatise of the Vinaya Piṭaka. The text systematically addresses the origins and origination of disciplinary offenses, detailing the various mental states and specific modes of origination applicable to monastic rules. An English translation of the text has been made by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
